# Dhdt

**Dhdt** is a flüssig (kontinuierlich gepumpt) ore. Each extraction yields **450** units, and the zone holds it in finite **deposits (nodes)** — when a node is mined below its threshold it is removed and the zone regenerates nodes up to its configured maximum. How the node-generation columns below are used by the server is in [Ore fields](/de/formats/ore-fields/).

## Förderung

| Property | Wert |
|---|---|
| Menge / Förderung | 450 |
| Förderungsart | flüssig (kontinuierlich gepumpt) |
| Aktivierungseffekt | nicht erforderlich |
| Geo-Scan-Dokument | definition 8706 |


This ore has no zone node configuration — it is not regenerated in any zone (it exists as a material for production and missions).
